personality_one_liner: A cinematic, dark-themed personal color analysis experience that reveals face tone harmony and custom makeup swatches with absolute elegance.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with cinematic margins, avoiding cramped layouts.

do's: Use frosted glass cards and headers for elevated surface layers
Apply translucent tinted base over dark atmospheric background
dont's: Never blur form inputs or text regions
Avoid low contrast text over glass

screens.name: ColorMatchScreen
screens.purpose: Single immersive screen allowing camera capture, gallery picker, offline rule-based face tone analysis, match percentage, detected tone, color swatches, manual fallback, and reset.

states.loading: Cinematic scanning animation with progress percentage over the captured portrait.
states.empty: Prompt card inviting user to snap a selfie or choose a gallery photo with clear glass styling.
states.error: Readable error message with a retry button for camera or file permissions.

screens.layout: Vertical single-column layout with fixed atmospheric dark background, glass header, hero image/capture preview frame, sticky bottom action bar, and scrollable results sheet containing match score, tone pill, palette swatches, and manual selector.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-screen dark elegant beauty color analysis app ('Chromatic Tone Match') that works entirely offline.
Support both camera capture and gallery photo picker with instant offline rule-based tone analysis.
Display match percentage (e.g. 92% Harmony), detected skin tone name, and recommended custom color swatches.
Include a manual tone selection fallback for user tuning.
Adhere strictly to the Glass / Luxe DARK personality (Fraunces + Switzer, obsidian background, champagne/gold accents, blur surfaces, weight cap 500 max, NO blue/purple/indigo banned hues).
